mapper.insert: INSERT INTO class_info (class_name, class_code, major, grade, teacher_id, description, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{className}, #{classCode}, #{major}, #{grade}, #{teacherId}, #{description}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE class_info SET class_name = #{className}, class_code = #{classCode}, major = #{major}, grade = #{grade}, teacher_id = #{teacherId}, description = #{description}, status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT c.*, u.real_name as teacher_name FROM class_info c LEFT JOIN user u ON c.teacher_id = u.id WHERE c.id = #{id}

SELECT c.*, u.real_name as teacher_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user WHERE class_id = c.id AND role = 'student') as student_count FROM class_info c LEFT JOIN user u ON c.teacher_id = u.id WHERE c.class_code = #{classCode}

SELECT c.*, u.real_name as teacher_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user WHERE class_id = c.id AND role = 'student') as student_count FROM class_info c LEFT JOIN user u ON c.teacher_id = u.id WHERE c.status = 1 ORDER BY c.create_time DESC

SELECT c.*, u.real_name as teacher_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user WHERE class_id = c.id AND role = 'student') as student_count FROM class_info c LEFT JOIN user u ON c.teacher_id = u.id WHERE c.teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND c.status = 1 ORDER BY c.create_time DESC

SELECT c.*, u.real_name as teacher_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user WHERE class_id = c.id AND role = 'student') as student_count FROM class_info c LEFT JOIN user u ON c.teacher_id = u.id WHERE c.status = 1 ORDER BY c.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM class_info WHERE status = 1

SELECT c.*, u.real_name as teacher_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user WHERE class_id = c.id AND role = 'student') as student_count FROM class_info c LEFT JOIN user u ON c.teacher_id = u.id WHERE c.status = 1
AND c.class_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{className}, '%')
AND c.class_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{classCode}, '%')
AND c.major LIKE CONCAT('%', #{major}, '%')
ORDER BY c.create_time DESC
